script:
onRoleReachedMoon = function() 
    game.pauseLogic()
	if global.getBool("lvl42_b1") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
			sound.play("54-1")
		    if dialog.show("Level42-1", faceManyi) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level42-2", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level42-3", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("50-1")
			if dialog.show("Level42-4", facePutong) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level42-5", faceManyi) ==1 then break end
			global.setBool("lvl42_b1")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    game.success()
end
